summary: Post-fix map403 regression executed on Expo browser preview with synthetic auth/Edge interception only. Shadow DOM map renderer, real OSM tile traffic, headers proof, fullscreen/day-switch interactions, and controlled failure/retry paths were tested; full frontend unit+TS+lint baseline re-run succeeded.

integration_issues.issue: Observed 67 OSM tile requests (target budget was ~40-60). Functional checks passed, but traffic budget exceeded in this run.
Leaflet JS request was observed, but script-failure error overlay was not deterministic in every fresh-context pass (ready state recovered without visible overlay in this environment).

react_native_issues.issue: WebKit binary unavailable in container Playwright runtime; cross-browser run could not be executed locally without installing toolchain.

action_items: Main agent should decide if tile budget optimization is needed for regression runs (67 observed vs target <=60).
If mandatory, harden deterministic script-failure UX assertion for fresh-context Leaflet load failures under cache variance.
Run equivalent iter83 script on an environment with WebKit installed to complete requested matrix coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: Web map adapter now validates canonical OSM URL + strict-origin-when-cross-origin and no iframe/srcDoc/eval/header-spoof patterns via unit/static guards.
iter81 harness previously frame_locator-based was updated to Shadow DOM selectors so future full regression can run against the current map adapter.
ServerRouteMap comment was stale (iframe wording) and now matches current Shadow DOM web adapter behavior.

success_rate.frontend: ~88% (core map403 checks passed; 3 follow-up gaps logged)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Positive evidence captured: Referer header equals preview origin with trailing slash; official tile host and image/png 200 with cache headers; map rendered with real cartography screenshots and server geometry payload/order checks. Chromium path passed through browser automation tool; direct Playwright launcher for Chromium/WebKit was unavailable in this container (missing browser binaries).
rca_of_issue: Original 403 policy symptom was tied to missing Referer under sandboxed iframe approach (iter82). Current run validates the post-fix non-iframe Shadow DOM adapter sends real browser Referer to OSM. Remaining gaps are test-environment determinism (script-failure overlay branch under cache) and tile-budget tuning, not a reproduced return of missing Referer/403 behavior.
